about: Denver metro, CO research for Veterans Day 2026, compiled 11 Nov 2026 (about 12:30-1:45 AM CST) from a research report (10 Nov) and checked against each source. Items here are region-wide perks, events on other days, and places outside the six route circles. Times are Mountain (MST, UTC-7).

other.name: Denver: metered parking is free
other.where: City and County of Denver street meters
other.offer: Meters and multi-space pay stations are free all day on Veterans Day. Posted time limits still apply, and payment resumes at midnight.
other.note: The city's Street Parking page lists Veterans Day, Nov 11, among the free-meter holidays (page copyright 2026, closure notice for Wednesday, Nov 11). Parking garages and lots are not covered.

other.name: Colorado state parks: free entry
other.where: All Colorado state parks (closest: Cherry Creek SP in Aurora, Chatfield SP near Littleton, Roxborough SP near Littleton)
other.offer: Free park entry for veterans, active-duty military and National Guard, 8 AM-10 PM. Camping and fishing fees still apply.
other.note: Proof: DD214, DD Form 2 or 2765, a military ID, a Colorado license marked Veteran, or a VA medical card. CPW's page: park entry offer applies though CPW offices are closed. Vehicles with Colorado Disabled Veteran or Purple Heart plates enter free all year (Gazette).

other.name: National Park Service: entrance fees waived
other.where: Fee-charging NPS sites, such as Rocky Mountain National Park and Great Sand Dunes
other.offer: Entrance fees waived for everyone at fee-charging National Park Service sites. Reservation and other fees may still apply.
other.note: KOOL 105 says U.S. citizens and residents. The NPS's own page was not checked.

other.name: Denver Zoo: Community Free Day
other.where: Denver Zoo, 2300 Steele St, Denver (inside circle 1, 2.0 km from its centre)
other.offer: A Community Free Day, open to everyone, with an advance timed ticket from the zoo's website. No walk-ups. Not a veterans-only offer.
other.note: The zoo's free-days page lists Wed 11 Nov 2026 with tickets released 28 Oct, first come, first served. The page does not say whether the day is sold out, and I could not check; assume tickets are gone. Hours are not on the free-days page. Next free days: Sat 14 Nov (tickets released 31 Oct) and Sun 22 Nov (released 8 Nov). Kept in extras because it needs a ticket booked in advance.

other.name: RTD: no Veterans Day fare change found
other.where: RTD bus and rail, Denver metro
other.offer: RTD publishes no free or reduced fare for veterans on 11 Nov 2026. Active-duty U.S. military ride free on all RTD services year-round, with proof.
other.note: RTD's fares page says: "Youth 19 and under and active-duty U.S. military ride free on all RTD services." and "Proof of eligibility is required for all Discount fare riders, youth, and active-duty military." It does not mention veterans or Veterans Day, and RTD's home page shows no Nov 11 alert (read 11 Nov). Not checked: RTD's Service Alerts page and its social posts, so say "RTD has not announced" rather than "there is none".

other.name: Denver and metro city offices closed
other.where: Denver, Westminster, Lakewood and Douglas County offices
other.offer: Most Denver city offices are closed (Mayor's Office, City Council, Clerk & Recorder, Auditor); Denver Health and DIA stay open. Westminster, Lakewood and Douglas County offices are closed too.
other.note: Denver per the Gazette; Westminster per its own Tribute Garden page; Douglas County per its own site; Lakewood per its holidays page (from a search snippet).

other.name: Westminster Golf: Walnut Creek
other.where: 10555 W Westmoor Dr, Westminster, CO 80021 (1.1 km outside circle 6)
other.offer: One free round for veterans and active military with valid ID; cart extra (KOOL 105). Same unconfirmed offer as Legacy Ridge in the local list.
other.note: Not on the City of Westminster's golf pages. Call the pro shop (Walnut Creek 303-658-2840 per a search result).

other.name: Broken Tee Golf Course, Englewood: free round
other.where: 2101 W Oxford Ave, Englewood, CO 80110 (1.0 km outside circle 4)
other.offer: One free round (green fee only) for veterans with a military ID on the Championship or Par 3 course; one round per veteran.
other.note: KOOL 105 (10 Nov 2026). The City of Englewood's veterans page (undated, from a search result) says the same for Veterans Day, so the offer is long-running. Phone 303-762-2670 (third-party listing). Cheap stretch: circle 4 radius 6.0 to 7.0 km reaches it.

other.name: Bonfire Burritos: free burrito
other.where: Golden (2221 Ford St), Arvada (5800 Olde Wadsworth Blvd) and Wheat Ridge (4001 Clear Creek Dr); Wheat Ridge is 0.8 km outside circle 3
other.offer: A free burrito for veterans and active-duty members.
other.note: Mile High on the Cheap (10 Nov 2026) names Arvada, Golden and Wheat Ridge. Bonfire's own site lists the three stores and hours (Golden 7-3, Arvada 6-2 weekdays, Wheat Ridge 6-2) but has no Veterans Day text. Wheat Ridge's OSM pin was not found; only the street (4001 Clear Creek Dr) is on the street segment, about 39.763,-105.145.

other.name: Holidaily Brewing, Golden: first pint free
other.where: 801 Brickyard Circle, Unit B, Golden, CO 80403 (13.8 km from circle 3)
other.offer: First pint free with a military ID, 2-9 PM at the Golden taproom.
other.note: KOOL 105 (10 Nov 2026) only. Holidaily's own 2022 event was a 10% donation day with a free first pint; no 2026 page found.

other.name: Emagine Parker: free movie ticket
other.where: 18625 Stage Run, Parker, CO 80134 (10.5 km from circle 5)
other.offer: A free movie ticket for veterans (the only Colorado Emagine).
other.note: Mile High on the Cheap (10 Nov 2026). The theater's own page was not checked.

other.name: Cherokee Ranch & Castle, Sedalia: free Veterans Day tour
other.where: 6113 N Daniels Park Rd, Sedalia, CO 80135 (about 16 km from circle 5)
other.offer: A free Veterans Day castle tour for veterans (others $22). Reservations required, 303-688-5555.
other.note: KOOL 105 (10 Nov 2026) gives the time and price. The ranch's own tours page lists a Veterans Day Tour under Other Tours with no date, time or price, and the same phone, 303-688-5555. Pin not computed (the address did not geocode); distance is approximate.

sources.publisher: Cherokee Ranch & Castle (tour name and phone only)

other.name: Veterans Day Car Show, Morrison
other.where: Vehicle procession past The Lodge at Red Rocks; drivers meet at the Morrison Post Office
other.offer: Free to watch. Drivers meet at 9 AM and should RSVP.
other.note: KOOL 105 (10 Nov 2026) only; the organizer's page was not found. Morrison is well outside every circle.

other.name: Parker Veterans Day fireworks
other.where: Launched from just northeast of Salisbury Park, Parker (Salisbury Regional Park; no street address)
other.offer: Free fireworks at 7 PM, weather permitting. Salisbury Regional Park North is closed; about 300 paved spaces; no parking along Parker Rd, Hess Rd or Main St.
other.note: The Town of Parker's own page. It is the July 4 show moved to Veterans Day after fire bans. Delays and cancellations go on the town's Facebook and X accounts. 10+ km from the circles.

other.name: Castle Rock Veterans Day fireworks
other.where: Miller's Landing, off Plum Creek Pkwy, Castle Rock
other.offer: Free fireworks at 7 PM, weather permitting. The July 4 show moved to Veterans Day after fire bans.
other.note: Denver7 and KOOL 105 say Miller's Landing off Plum Creek Pkwy; a search summary said Philip S. Miller Park, 1375 W Plum Creek Pkwy, which is not the same name. The town's page (crgov.com/2658/Fireworks-in-Castle-Rock) was not read.

other.name: Aurora Veterans Salute
other.where: Wings Over the Rockies, 7711 E Academy Blvd
other.offer: $20 per person: museum access, appetizers and refreshments, music by Bianca and the Fly Boys with swing dance demonstrations.
other.note: City of Aurora's page (year not printed; Nov 12 is a Thursday in 2026). A search summary said tickets were sold through Wed 4 Nov, which I could not verify, so call before going.

other.name: Denver Veterans Day Run, Parade and Festival
other.offer: Free to attend. Parade 10:30 AM-noon, festival 9:30 AM-2:30 PM with a beer garden, vendors and kids' activities; 5K, 10K and 10K Rippetoe Rucksack Challenge need registration (runs 8:30-10:15 AM).
other.note: Denver Gazette (10 Nov 2026) and Colorado Sound (2 Nov 2026). The organizer (Colorado Veterans Project) page was not read.

other.name: VETEFITS benefits-navigation day
other.offer: Free for veterans and families; register free online or at the check-in table; doors open at noon.
other.note: VETEFITS' own page. Its banners conflict (this Saturday, tomorrow, thank you to everyone who came), so confirm the date. Search found no second source.

leads.name: Factotum Brewhouse
leads.area: 3845 Lipan St, Denver (inside circle 1, 5.0 km from its centre)
leads.q: Factotum Brewhouse Veterans Day 2026 Soldier's Reward Pilsner
leads.offer: A Westword roundup (year not shown) says Factotum pours free Soldier's Reward Pilsner every Veterans Day for anyone showing proof of service. No 2026 page found.

leads.name: FlyteCo Brewing
leads.area: Denver (4437 W 38th Ave per OSM; the lead's Vets in Jets page lists 3120 Uinta St)
leads.q: FlyteCo Vets in Jets cream ale Veterans Day 2026
leads.offer: Vets in Jets Cream Ale with a free pint for vets. FlyteCo's own page found is for 11 Nov 2022 (7 AM-11 PM at 3120 Uinta St); Westword (year not shown) lists a release. No 2026 page.

leads.name: Broomfield Veterans Day ceremony
leads.area: Veterans Memorial Museum, 12 Garden Center, Broomfield (inside circle 6, about 6.6 km)
leads.q: Broomfield Veterans Memorial Museum Veterans Day ceremony 2026
leads.offer: Colorado Sound (2 Nov 2026) lists a Wed 11 Nov ceremony at the Broomfield Veterans Memorial Museum with no time or address; the museum events line is 303-460-6801 (search result).

leads.name: U.S. Navy Band Commodores at Dazzle
leads.q: Navy Band Commodores Dazzle Denver 17 Nov 2026
leads.offer: The lead says two free jazz concerts Tue 17 Nov at 6 and 8:30 PM. No Dazzle or Navy Band listing found; the band's Nov 11 concerts were in Phoenix.
leads.last_seen: lead report (Mile High on the Cheap per the report)

navyband.publisher: Mile High on the Cheap (the lead's source; I did not find it on the page)
